xna-type.name: NetworkGamer
xna-type.summary: Represents a player in a network session.
xna-type.remarks: The NetworkSession class maintains a list of players in a network session. Some of the players may also be local players, which are represented LocalNetworkGamer .

property.name: HasLeftSession
property.summary: Indicates whether this gamer has left the session.
property.value: true if the player has left the session; false, otherwise.

property.name: HasVoice
property.summary: Determines if the player has a voice headset.
property.value: true if a headset is present; false otherwise.

property.name: Id
property.summary: Gets a unique identifier that can be used to refer to this gamer in network packets.
property.value: A unique identifier that can be used to refer to this gamer in network packets.
property.remarks: This value is synchronized across all the machines in the session, so it can be used in situations where gamer A wants to send a packet to B, and the contents of this packet must refer to gamer C. Using the identifier is preferable to sending the index of the gamer within the session, because indices could change if gamers join or leave in mid session, but this id will always remain constant. To look up a gamer once you know their id, use FindGamerById .

property.name: IsGuest
property.summary: Determines whether this gamer is logged in as a guest profile.
property.value: true if this gamer is logged in as a guest profile; false otherwise.

property.name: IsHost
property.summary: Determines if the player is the host of the multiplayer session.
property.value: true if the player is the host; false otherwise.

property.name: IsLocal
property.summary: Determines if the player is playing on a local machine.
property.value: true if the player is local; false otherwise.

property.name: IsMutedByLocalUser
property.summary: Determines if the player is muted by one or more local users.
property.value: true if the player is muted by one or more players in the session; false otherwise.

property.name: IsPrivateSlot
property.summary: Determines if the player occupies a reserved private session slot.
property.value: true if the player occupies a reserved private session slot; false otherwise.

property.name: IsReady
property.summary: Determines whether the gamer is ready to leave the lobby screen and begin gameplay.
property.value: true if the gamer is ready to start playing; false otherwise.

exceptions.exception: This operation is only valid when the session state is NetworkSessionState.Lobby. This method cannot be called on remote gamer instances. It is only valid when NetworkGamer.IsLocal is true. If you are looping over the contents of the NetworkSession.AllGamers collection, consider using NetworkSession.LocalGamers instead.
This NetworkGamer is no longer valid. The gamer may have left the session.

property.remarks: The host of a multiplayer session can use the IsEveryoneReady property to detect when all players have marked themselves ready, and then call StartGame to kick off the game.

property.name: IsTalking
property.summary: Determines whether the gamer is currently sending voice data.
property.value: true if the gamer is sending voice data; false otherwise.

property.name: Machine
property.summary: Gets an object representing the physical gaming machine this NetworkGamer is playing on.
property.value: An object representing the physical gaming machine this NetworkGamer is playing on.
property.remarks: If there are several gamers all playing on the same gaming machine, they will all share a single value for the Machine property.

property.name: RoundtripTime
property.summary: Gets an estimate of the network latency involved in sending a packet round trip from the local machine to this gamer and back again.
property.value: An estimate of the network latency involved in sending a packet round trip from the local machine to this gamer and back again.
property.remarks: This value does not include latency introduced via the MultiplayerSession.SimulateLatency property.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Gets the multiplayer session of the gamer.
